title: Diffractive Production of Heavy Quarkonia at the Electron Ion Collider
summary: We study diffractive photo- and electroproduction of the $S$-wave heavy quarkonia $J/ψ$, $ψ(2S)$, and $Υ(nS)$ at energies relevant for the Electron-Ion Collider (EIC). The production amplitude is evaluated while retaining the full transverse-momentum ($\ell_t$) dependence of the hard two-gluon kernel, that is, without expanding the impact-parameter Bessel kernel as is done in the small-size color-dipole limit.
